entries.8f17731e0debccd5: A company that develops databases systematizing sensibility data such as music and video, and provides businesses with data services such as recommendation and search.
entries.9bd3ee0c64878393: The company has set out a mission of 'connecting human feelings' and a basic policy emphasizing research and development and data development. Over the medium to long term, it states that it aims to expand the top-ranked database in Japan in the entertainment fields of music and video, expand the emotion-targeted advertising service 'Trig's', and open up the emotional marketing market. Furthermore, it states that it plans to develop a mechanism linking IP content from discovery through production, distribution and promotion via data, to transition from a data and system provider into a company that originates and amplifies IP content, and to globally expand its data services.
entries.ab0c299215c6cfcf: The company has developed a proprietary database (MSDB) that systematizes emotions and characteristics in addition to basic information on music and video, and provides data provision, recommendation, personalization, search and data analytics services, as well as emotion-targeted advertising.
entries.af6ddffbb4663027: Its strength lies in accumulating emotional metadata that systematizes not only basic information on music and video but also detailed characteristics such as types of instruments and playing techniques, themes, worldviews and characters, along with emotional information, and in developing and operating it as MSDB, one of the largest emotional databases in Japan. Using this data and emotional AI, it provides emotion-responsive data services, such as recommendations that introduce users to works and products they do not yet know.
